roles.title: Assistant Product Owner, CCA Mission Autonomy (Platform Integration) (R5849)

bullets: Work with the Product Owner and Chief Engineer to understand customer product needs (across the CCA program office, platform providers, and operational end users) and to determine…
Elicit and validate needs and priorities from the customer, including official guidance and scoping documents, and from operational subject matter experts or surrogate end users…
Translate customer intent into customer needs into user stories and epic descriptions — including value proposition, success criteria, acceptance criteria, expected effort and…
Own day-to-day management of the Shoal 1 epic backlog across feature crews, including maintaining traceability with customer requirements, refining the backlog, and monitoring…
Provide a product perspective to feature crews at Shoal 1-specific sprint planning and review ceremonies, by maintaining an informal integrated product map of epics, interfaces…
Own product definition, roadmap, and metrics across the office of the CTO's agentic AI portfolio: an enterprise knowledge assistant (Brain), an agent-driven engineering platform…
Translate CTO strategy into crisp requirements, milestones, exit criteria, and KPIs — then hold the line on them.
Drive adoption of internal platforms: reduce onboarding friction, instrument usage, track NPS and active users, and run developer advocacy and objection handling.
Shape product direction for foundation-model based autonomy architectures and model lifecycle tooling (evaluation, fine-tuning, verification, deployment).
Run continuous discovery with engineers, operators, and executive stakeholders; turn findings into prioritized backlogs.
